item.title: Sharpe and Agbaji lead Nets to 2nd straight win, 126-115 over injury-plagued Grizzlies
item.description: Day'Ron Sharpe matched a season high with 19 points, Ochai Agbaji added 18 and the Brooklyn Nets beat the injury-plagued Memphis Grizzlies 126-115 for their second straight victory.

item.title: US allies and rivals in Asia gauge fallout from war in the Middle East
item.description: North Korea, South Korea, Japan, and China are watching warily as war spreads across the Middle East.

item.title: Northern Arizona University student died of alcohol poisoning following rush event, autopsy says
item.description: An autopsy report shows a Northern Arizona University died of alcohol poisoning after drinking an excessive amount of vodka during a fraternity party.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ties Wilt's record and hits winning 3 as Thunder beat Nuggets 129-126
item.description: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander drilled a step-back 3-pointer with 2.7 seconds left to cap a frantic final minute on a night he matched Wilt Chamberlain's record for consecutive 20-point games, and the Oklahoma City beat the Denver Nuggets 129-126.

item.title: Broncos keeping their core intact. Linebacker Alex Singleton returns as Dre Greenlaw exits
item.description: The Denver Broncos focused on keeping their core together and clearing cap space by moving on from a hurt-prone defender.

item.title: No. 12 Gonzaga beats Oregon State 65-56, advances to 29th straight WCC final
item.description: Graham Ike had 24 points and 11 rebounds to lead No. 12 Gonzaga to a 65-56 victory over Oregon State on Monday night and put the Bulldogs in the West Coast Conference Tournament championship game for the 29th straight time.

item.title: Iran launches new attacks at Gulf Arab countries as it keeps up pressure on the Middle East
item.description: Iran has fired more drones and missiles at Gulf Arab countries as it keeps up pressure on the Middle East in a war that has sent oil prices surging and stunned global economies.

item.title: China's exports surge in Jan-Feb despite waning trade with the US
item.description: China has reported its exports rose nearly 22% in the first two months of the year, while trade with the United States contracted.

item.title: Hofstra reaches CAA Tournament final on Preston Edmead's banked three-pointer with three-tenths of a second left in overtime
item.description: The Pride (23-10) have won six in a row and are one win away from clinching a berth in the NCAA Tournament.

item.title: Frank Nazar scores OT power-play goal as Blackhawks beat Utah Mammoth 3-2
item.description: Frank Nazar scored a power-play goal with 2:24 left in overtime to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 3-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth.
